@graph.name: Industrial and B2B marketing
@graph.description: A website and tools that match your plant: bilingual technical website, product and capability pages, qualified quote requests and custom software for manufacturers and B2B companies.

acceptedAnswer.text: Your buyers, distributors and OEM customers are often outside Quebec. A technical site in French and English presents your capabilities to both markets and meets B2B buyer expectations.

mainEntity.name: What should a manufacturer's website include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clear product and capability pages (processes, equipment, materials, tolerances, certifications), past projects, and a quote request form that collects the right information from the start.

mainEntity.name: How do you qualify quote requests?

acceptedAnswer.text: With a structured form (part type, quantities, materials, deadline, attached files) connected to your CRM, so your team receives complete, prioritized requests.

mainEntity.name: Do you build custom software for manufacturers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes: client portals, dashboards, ERP or CRM integrations and automation of repetitive tasks, designed around your processes.
